title: Second monitor not detected on docking station
description: I'm connecting two monitors to the Dell docking station I just received, but only one works. When I plug the same cable directly into the laptop, the monitor works fine.

worklogs.description: Dock firmware upgraded to 2.1.0 via Dell Command | Update.
Selected 'Extend' via Win+P, updated the driver and restarted; the second monitor still isn't getting a signal.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I'll test with a spare dock; I've asked the user for their availability tomorrow.
